name: Taksh Mehta
headline: Mechanical Engineering Student | Robotics, CAD & Software
intro: I'm Taksh Mehta, a Mechanical Engineering student at CHARUSAT who learns by building, testing, and improving practical projects.
about: I'm a Mechanical Engineering student at CHARUSAT interested in robotics, mechanical design, programming, and practical engineering.
I enjoy learning by making things: modelling parts in SolidWorks, experimenting with electronics, building software, and testing ideas.
My current work includes HabitLens, a personal habit-tracking app; a line-following robot that placed third in Track Trace 2.0; and a growing collection of 50+ SolidWorks models and assemblies.
I'm early in my engineering journey, so I focus on strong fundamentals, documenting what I learn, and being clear about what is complete versus still in progress.
